text_block_list.text:
On the way home from
an outing with Silence Suzuka—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Oh? Rain?
(Shwaaaaaah...)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Kya...!
Caught in a sudden downpour, I scrambled frantically into the school building.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
*Sigh*...
We got caught in the rain, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...What should I do?
I was planning on going for a run after this.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Even if I go back to the dorms, I'll probably just be bored out of my mind...
choice_data_list: Isn't there anything to do indoors?
Isn't there anything we can do indoors?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Indoors—no, wait.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um, nothing in particular comes to mind.
What should I do...?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ah, come to think of it, I feel like we got
a lot of homework in class the other day...
choice_data_list: Then you can focus on that today.
Then you can focus on that today.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Still, um.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
The weather was so nice that I kept thinking
about going outside to run, and I missed the lecture...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
—Um, Trainer.
Would you mind giving me a hand if you're free?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes. All on my own, it's a bit...

And so, I ended up helping
Silence Suzuka with her assignment, but—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
—Um.
May I double-check one more time?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
First, find the length here.
Then apply it to the formula... right?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Um, calculating, calculating...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um. Once I finish this problem,
would it be okay if I took a short break—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Right.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
…………Ah.
Did it... come undone?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um, Trainer-san...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
It seems I can solve the other problems the same way.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...So, um. If possible,
I'd like you to look over my other subjects, too."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"If it's sunny tomorrow, I want to make up for today's run too...
So I want to finish this up right now."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I feel like if you're with me, Trainer,
it'll go smoothly.
choice_data_list: I'll help out as much as you need!
I'll help out as much as you need!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes! Even so, there are still plenty left—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: There are truly... so many...
We managed to finish the assignment... but by that time, the sun had completely set.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Cooking... is it?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Normally, I at least prepare my own rice balls
to eat during my run, but—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I don't really do anything too elaborate myself...
choice_data_list: Managing your nutrition is part of training too
Managing your nutrition is part of training too, you know

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...Now that you mention it.
It is all to run faster, after all."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes, please.
Do teach me.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
“—I see. Running too much makes one prone
to sports anemia...”

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"So to do that, I have to
take in plenty of iron, huh."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...Understood.
I'll go home and put it into practice right away."
And the next morning—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Um... this is for you.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I tried making something. A homemade dish packed full of iron.
I sautéed some spinach and liver...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, Trainer,
please help yourself to some nutrition.

With Silence Suzuka saying so,
I decided to try eating it right away.
(Chomp! Munch, munch...)
choice_data_list: ...Taste the natural flavor of the ingredients!
...Taste the natural flavor of the ingredients!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh? The taste...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
—Ah.
E-Excuse me!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
If I was going to have Trainer eat it,
I really should have seasoned it properly...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
When it's just for my own post-run meal, as long
as I get the nutrients, it's fine... so I just made it the usual way.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: D-Do you think so...?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I’ll make it again next time for sure.
I’ll have Spe-chan taste-test it, too.”

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: So, um... please have some again.
For the next few days, our lunches consisted of stir-fried liver and spinach—

Silence Suzuka's cooking had improved so much
that it could now genuinely be called delicious.
